===Starting out===
{{Checklist|
*Climb down the [[trapdoor (Canifis)|trapdoor]] behind the [[Hair of the Dog|Canifis pub]].
*Search the [[wall (The Hollows)|wall]] and enter the cave entrance just south-east.
*Talk to [[Veliaf Hurtz]]. {{Chat option|1I want to join your organisation.}}}}
